payload.objective: Descriptive estimand for TCGA-LUAD (public GDC records): over an explicitly bounded, source-identified GDC /cases slice restricted to project TCGA-LUAD, characterise the RECORDED clinical age at diagnosis (demographic.age_at_index; units = years). Question: how many cases in the declared bounded slice carry a recorded age, and what is the distribution (median, IQR, min/max, units=years) of those recorded values? Declare the exact slice bound, the endpoint and requested fields, and the exact retrieved case count, so that bounded-slice coverage is explicit and a slice count is never presented as a population total. Treat unreturned or missing age values as unavailable, never zero. Do not infer mutation absence, callable territory, survival endpoints or expert review; do not treat file-level metadata as mutation measurements. Compare representation/method alternatives available in the local index before fixing the summary. Check public literature context and challenge the descriptive result if an eligible method exists; otherwise retain the exact unavailable prerequisite as an explicit state. An inconclusive result is acceptable; report actual limitations and the next useful test.
